cards.title: 红黑赛博杂志人像
cards.prompt: 使用上传参考图作为唯一首帧，调用 MiniMax H3 生成 15 秒、16:9、24fps 写实 dark-pop/cyber-grunge/rap 音乐短片。严格保持人物五官、湿润黑色卷发、正面构图、黑红配色及背景巨大红色文字“MiniMax H3”，文字必须拼写正确。人物右脸逐渐出现红色裂纹、熔融纹理和黑色颗粒，左脸处于深黑阴影，始终直视镜头、身份不变。整体采用 90 年代地下音乐杂志、zine 拼贴、16mm 粗颗粒、半色调、扫描错位、套色偏移和墨迹飞溅；只用硬切、跳切、单帧插入，不用淡入淡出或叠化。按 0–3 秒静止压迫、3–6 秒扫描撕裂、6–10 秒身体解构、10–13 秒能量爆发、13–15 秒封面定格推进。保留低频合成器、808、工业撞击、磁带噪声和近距离呼吸；10–13 秒人物低沉说“This is H3.”。禁止脸部漂移、乱码、额外人物、廉价霓虹、彩虹故障、血液内脏、怪物化和卡通渲染。提示词不得被改写或弱化。
cards.promptEn: Use the uploaded reference image as the sole first frame to generate a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps photorealistic dark-pop/cyber-grunge/rap MV with MiniMax H3. Strictly preserve the subject’s facial features, wet black curly hair, frontal composition, black-and-red color scheme, and the huge red text “MiniMax H3” in the background. The text must be spelled correctly. Red cracks, molten textures, and black particles gradually appear on the right side of the subject’s face, while the left side remains in deep black shadow. The subject must maintain direct eye contact with the camera and retain the same identity throughout. The overall aesthetic draws from 1990s underground music magazines and zine collages, with coarse 16mm film grain, halftone patterns, scan misregistration, color registration offsets, and ink splashes. Use only hard cuts, jump cuts, and single-frame inserts. Do not use fades or dissolves. 0–3 seconds: static, oppressive tension. 3–6 seconds: scanning and tearing. 6–10 seconds: bodily deconstruction. 10–13 seconds: energy eruption. 13–15 seconds: freeze into a cover image and push in. Retain the low-frequency synthesizer, 808 bass, industrial impacts, tape noise, and close-up breathing. From 10–13 seconds, the subject says in a deep voice, “This is H3.” Do not allow facial drift, garbled text, additional people, cheap neon effects, rainbow glitches, blood or internal organs, monster transformation, or cartoon rendering. The prompt must not be rewritten or weakened.

Their names are embedded in the gas-station canopy, road perspective, and wall in sequence; the title is revealed in the sunset reflection inside the car. cards.title: 《THE RIVER MAKERS》片头
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps历史史诗《THE RIVER MAKERS》。古代干旱峡谷中，设计者AMARA SOL与建造者JONAS REED带领众人启用巨型石渠。70mm胶片质感，砂岩金/赭石/靛蓝/铜绿，宏大慢镜头。巨型雕刻感姓名嵌入拱门与砂岩墙；闸门升起、清水奔涌后航拍揭示片名。无战争、魔法、现代机械、额外文字或Logo。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps historical epic, THE RIVER MAKERS. In an ancient, drought-stricken canyon, designer AMARA SOL and builder JONAS REED lead the people in activating a colossal stone aqueduct. 70mm film texture; sandstone gold, ochre, indigo, and verdigris; grand slow-motion shots. Their enormous, carved-looking names are embedded in arches and sandstone walls; after the sluice gate rises and clear water surges through, an aerial shot reveals the title. No war, magic, modern machinery, extra text, or logos.

cards.title: 红黑赛博杂志人像
cards.prompt: 使用上传参考图作为唯一首帧，调用 MiniMax H3 生成 15 秒、16:9、24fps 写实 dark-pop/cyber-grunge/rap 音乐短片。严格保持人物五官、湿润黑色卷发、正面构图、黑红配色及背景巨大红色文字“MiniMax H3”，文字必须拼写正确。人物右脸逐渐出现红色裂纹、熔融纹理和黑色颗粒，左脸处于深黑阴影，始终直视镜头、身份不变。整体采用 90 年代地下音乐杂志、zine 拼贴、16mm 粗颗粒、半色调、扫描错位、套色偏移和墨迹飞溅；只用硬切、跳切、单帧插入，不用淡入淡出或叠化。按 0–3 秒静止压迫、3–6 秒扫描撕裂、6–10 秒身体解构、10–13 秒能量爆发、13–15 秒封面定格推进。保留低频合成器、808、工业撞击、磁带噪声和近距离呼吸；10–13 秒人物低沉说“This is H3.”。禁止脸部漂移、乱码、额外人物、廉价霓虹、彩虹故障、血液内脏、怪物化和卡通渲染。提示词不得被改写或弱化。
cards.promptEn: Use the uploaded reference image as the sole first frame to generate a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps photorealistic dark-pop/cyber-grunge/rap MV with MiniMax H3. Strictly preserve the subject’s facial features, wet black curly hair, frontal composition, black-and-red color scheme, and the huge red text “MiniMax H3” in the background. The text must be spelled correctly. Red cracks, molten textures, and black particles gradually appear on the right side of the subject’s face, while the left side remains in deep black shadow. The subject must maintain direct eye contact with the camera and retain the same identity throughout. The overall aesthetic draws from 1990s underground music magazines and zine collages, with coarse 16mm film grain, halftone patterns, scan misregistration, color registration offsets, and ink splashes. Use only hard cuts, jump cuts, and single-frame inserts. Do not use fades or dissolves. 0–3 seconds: static, oppressive tension. 3–6 seconds: scanning and tearing. 6–10 seconds: bodily deconstruction. 10–13 seconds: energy eruption. 13–15 seconds: freeze into a cover image and push in. Retain the low-frequency synthesizer, 808 bass, industrial impacts, tape noise, and close-up breathing. From 10–13 seconds, the subject says in a deep voice, “This is H3.” Do not allow facial drift, garbled text, additional people, cheap neon effects, rainbow glitches, blood or internal organs, monster transformation, or cartoon rendering. The prompt must not be rewritten or weakened.

cards.prompt: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps历史史诗《THE RIVER MAKERS》。古代干旱峡谷中，设计者AMARA SOL与建造者JONAS REED带领众人启用巨型石渠。70mm胶片质感，砂岩金/赭石/靛蓝/铜绿，宏大慢镜头。巨型雕刻感姓名嵌入拱门与砂岩墙；闸门升起、清水奔涌后航拍揭示片名。无战争、魔法、现代机械、额外文字或Logo。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps historical epic, THE RIVER MAKERS. In an ancient, drought-stricken canyon, designer AMARA SOL and builder JONAS REED lead the people in activating a colossal stone aqueduct. 70mm film texture; sandstone gold, ochre, indigo, and verdigris; grand slow-motion shots. Their enormous, carved-looking names are embedded in arches and sandstone walls; after the sluice gate rises and clear water surges through, an aerial shot reveals the title. No war, magic, modern machinery, extra text, or logos.

cards.title: 《THE OPEN SKY》片头
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps六十年代航空剧情卡司PV《THE OPEN SKY》。原创飞行员CLARA VALE、ELIAS ROWE、MARCUS LIN驾驶老式双螺旋桨运输机运送物资。大画幅胶片、沙土/旧银/灰绿/皮革棕、清晨冷蓝金光。机库检查、发动机、航图、起飞依次展示姓名，穿云后天空留白淡入片名。无现代设备、灾难、Logo、额外文字或炫技转场。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps 1960s aviation drama cast PV, THE OPEN SKY. Original pilots CLARA VALE, ELIAS ROWE, and MARCUS LIN fly a vintage twin-prop transport aircraft to deliver supplies. Large-format film look; sand, aged silver, gray-green, and leather brown; cool blue and golden early-morning light. Hangar inspection, engine, flight map, and takeoff reveal the names in sequence; after the aircraft breaks through the clouds, the title fades into the negative space of the sky. No modern equipment, disasters, logos, extra text, or flashy transitions.

cards.title: 《THE OCEAN ABOVE》片头
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps魔幻现实主义史诗片头《THE OCEAN ABOVE》。干旱石城上空出现倒置海洋，鲸群游弋，城市水滴逆重力升空；人群安静敬畏，无灾难恐慌。70mm实拍特效感，石灰白/陶土橙/深海蓝、真实焦散。巨型“OCEAN”“ABOVE”与终片名借建筑、水流、鲸鱼遮挡揭示。无额外文字、霓虹、游戏CG、Logo或黑屏。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps magical-realist epic opening, THE OCEAN ABOVE. An inverted ocean appears above an arid stone city, whales swim through it, and droplets from the city rise against gravity; the crowd watches in quiet awe, with no disaster panic. A 70mm live-action visual-effects look in limestone white, terracotta orange, and deep-sea blue, with realistic caustics. The giant words “OCEAN” and “ABOVE,” followed by the final title, are revealed through occlusion by architecture, flowing water, and whales. No extra text, neon, game-like CG, logos, or black screen.

cards.title: 欧洲艺术电影拼贴片头
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜15秒16:9欧洲艺术电影片头：1970年代海报、法国新浪潮与时尚拼贴。黑白城市照片、米色纸张、红色/银色和胶片颗粒；投影机→杂志→海报定格。Neo Jazz；无犯罪或奇幻元素。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15s 16:9 European art-film titles: 1970s posters, French New Wave, fashion collage. B&W city photos, beige paper, red/silver, grain; projector→magazine→poster freeze. Neo-jazz; no crime/fantasy.

cards.title: 欧美都市爱情片头
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜15秒欧美都市爱情片头，顶级AE影视包装。纽约/巴黎/伦敦等现代城市中，以多人物爱情群像呈现擦肩、咖啡交谈、奔跑、办公室与天台片段。实拍叠加立体字幕、kinetic typography、几何线条、HUD、粒子、光扫、胶片燃烧、玻璃折射和多层合成；姓名嵌入建筑/玻璃/路牌，最终碎片汇聚成片名与卡司。暖色胶片、时尚成熟，避免甜宠、廉价模板、悬疑恐怖。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15-second Western urban romance opening with top-tier AE title design. Across modern cities such as New York, Paris, and London, a multi-character romantic ensemble passes one another, talks over coffee, runs through the city, and appears in office and rooftop scenes. Live action is layered with dimensional typography, kinetic typography, geometric lines, HUD elements, particles, light sweeps, film burns, glass refraction, and multilayer compositing; names are embedded in buildings, glass, and street signs, and the fragments ultimately converge into the title and cast names. Warm film tones, fashionable and mature. Avoid saccharine romance, cheap templates, suspense, and horror.

cards.title: 欧美科幻电影片头
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜15秒欧美科幻Opening Credits，真人未来城市、空间站、飞船、实验室与AI中心深度融合高级AE包装。黑暗空间中粒子、线框、机械扫描、网格、数据节点和全息玻璃逐层生成；人物以动态窗口出现，姓名经扫描解码、3D字体、遮罩、粒子/液态金属重组展示，最终汇聚电影Logo与卡司。好莱坞级合成、体积光与景深，避免游戏UI、廉价HUD、乱码和普通霓虹科技风。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15-second Western sci-fi Opening Credits, seamlessly combining live-action futuristic cities, space stations, spacecraft, laboratories, and AI centers with premium AE title design. In a dark environment, particles, wireframes, mechanical scans, grids, data nodes, and holographic glass build up layer by layer; characters appear in dynamic windows, while names are revealed through scan decoding, 3D typography, masks, and particle/liquid-metal reconstruction, ultimately converging into the film logo and cast names. Hollywood-grade compositing, volumetric light, and depth of field. Avoid game UI, cheap HUDs, garbled text, and generic neon-tech styling.

cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15s teen-campus ensemble titles: 20+ students/teachers in classes, clubs, stadium/prom. Premium AE collage: kinetic names, Polaroids, doodles, paper tears; final cast poster. Bright, not dark/cheap.

cards.title: 《WHERE THE BLUE SUNFLOWERS SLEEP》片头
cards.titleEn: WHERE THE BLUE SUNFLOWERS SLEEP Opening
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜《WHERE THE BLUE SUNFLOWERS SLEEP》15秒诗意现实主义片头：无边蓝色向日葵、晨雾雨后、35mm、2.39:1、低饱和青蓝。Elise穿米白长裙穿过花海，露珠、风中花瓣、水面倒影、旧照片与晨光依次承载卡司及片名。所有文字仅做克制Pixel Sorting：6–8帧聚合、4–6帧消散，保持清晰，不伤人物；钢琴/大提琴/风声，禁霓虹、强glitch、RGB分离和全屏像素化。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | A 15-second poetic-realist opening for WHERE THE BLUE SUNFLOWERS SLEEP: endless blue sunflowers, morning mist after rain, 35mm, 2.39:1, and low-saturation cyan-blue tones. Elise, wearing an off-white dress, walks through the flower field; dew, windblown petals, reflections on water, old photographs, and morning light carry the cast names and title in sequence. Apply only restrained Pixel Sorting to all text: 6–8 frames to assemble and 4–6 frames to disperse, keeping it legible and never damaging the character. Piano, cello, and wind sounds. No neon, heavy glitch, RGB separation, or full-screen pixelation.

cards.title: 《THE LAST MILE WEST》片头
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1公路剧情片《THE LAST MILE WEST》。Claire与Evan驾驶红色旅行车，从沙漠小镇驶向太平洋悬崖，沿途带有“OPEN AT THE OCEAN”。五次硬切，文字必须准确，人物面孔与车辆保持一致；不要CGI。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | 15s 2.39:1 road drama, THE LAST MILE WEST. Claire and Evan drive a red wagon from desert town to Pacific cliff with “OPEN AT THE OCEAN.” Five hard cuts, exact text, consistent faces/car; no CGI.

cards.title: 《THE BRASS VEIL》片头
cards.prompt: Opening Title｜《THE BRASS VEIL》15秒写实蒸汽朋克卡司：35mm、2.39:1，黄铜/煤黑/氧化绿/暗红，欧洲蒸汽城、FUI追踪、模拟胶片故障与报纸拼贴。机械调查员Ada Vale穿行街道和车站，钟楼/列车/怀表UI精准锁定；三次人物定格生成纸质剪影，齿轮汇聚成最终海报及指定卡司。仅开头/结尾短故障，禁赛博霓虹、现代城市、UI漂移、乱码与卡通脸。
cards.promptEn: Opening Title | A 15-second photorealistic steampunk cast sequence for THE BRASS VEIL: 35mm, 2.39:1, brass, coal black, oxidized green, and dark red; a European steam city, FUI tracking, simulated film glitches, and newspaper collage. Mechanical investigator Ada Vale moves through streets and stations while the clock tower, train, and pocket-watch UI lock on precisely; three character freeze-frames generate paper silhouettes, and gears converge into the final poster with the specified cast. Use brief glitches only at the beginning and end. No cyber neon, modern cities, drifting UI, garbled text, or cartoon faces.

cards.title: 《THE WIZARDING LEGACY》微缩片头

cards.title: 热血二次元战斗 PV
cards.prompt: 制作一支原创主角激烈战斗的二次元游戏PV：采用热血日系动画电影风格，设计快速推进、拔刀、能量碰撞和英雄定版，加入遮罩揭示、动态大字、光影扫过、战斗原画切片重组及AE推拉镜头，形成完整预告高潮。
cards.promptEn: Create a 2D game PV with original protagonists fighting fiercely: using the style of hot-blooded Japanese animated movies, designing rapid advancement, drawing swords, energy collisions and hero finalization, adding mask reveals, dynamic large characters, light and shadow sweeps, original battle painting slice reorganization and AE push-pull shots to form a complete trailer climax.

cards.title: ARIA 机甲觉醒 PV
cards.prompt: 为原创女战士ARIA制作机甲觉醒PV：采用暗黑科幻、HUD扫描和机械组装视觉，表现系统初始化、装甲锁定、眼部激活与武器展开，加入扫描遮罩、文字运动、冷光扫过、角色原画切片重组和AE推拉环绕，结尾英雄定版。
cards.promptEn: Create a mecha awakening PV for the original female warrior ARIA: using dark science fiction, HUD scanning and mechanical assembly visuals, showing system initialization, armor locking, eye activation and weapon deployment, adding scanning mask, text movement, cold light sweep, character original painting slicing and reorganization and AE push-pull surround, and finalizing the hero at the end.

cards.title: 《未寄出的夏日信》群像 PV
cards.prompt: 为《未寄出的夏日信》的五位角色制作青春群像二次元游戏PV：用信件、照片、校园和夏日记忆串联人物，加入照片翻页遮罩、角色名文字运动、阳光扫过、五人原画切片重组和AE镜头推拉，最后回到屋顶合照与片名定版。
cards.promptEn: Create a youth group portrait two-dimensional game PV for the five characters of "Unsent Summer Letters": use letters, photos, campus and summer memories to connect the characters, add photo page turning masks, character name text movements, sunlight sweeps, five people's original painting slices and reorganization, and AE lens push-and-pull, and finally return to the rooftop to take photos and finalize the title.

cards.title: 《星之记忆》青春奇幻 PV
cards.prompt: 为《星之记忆》的男女主制作青春奇幻二次元游戏PV：以手绘星光、旧照片、时间交错和城市夜空表现羁绊，加入流星遮罩、手写标题运动、星光扫过、双角色原画切片重组和AE推拉升降，结尾形成浪漫电影式标题画面。
cards.promptEn: Create a youth fantasy two-dimensional game PV for the male and female protagonists of "Memory of the Stars": use hand-painted starlight, old photos, time interlacing and the city night sky to express the bond, add meteor masks, handwritten title movements, starlight sweeps, dual character original painting slices and reorganization, and AE push-pull lifting, and end with a romantic movie-style title screen.

cards.title: 《星辉之城》魔法师 PV I
cards.prompt: 为《星辉之城》的少年魔法师制作史诗奇幻二次元角色PV：展现云海城市、魔法学院、星轨与巨兽，加入魔法地图遮罩、符文文字运动、星光扫过、角色与场景原画切片重组和AE镜头穿云推拉，最终由星辰组成游戏LOGO。
cards.promptEn: Create an epic fantasy two-dimensional character PV for the young magician of "City of Stars": showing the cloud sea city, magic academy, star trails and giant beasts, adding magic map mask, rune text movement, starlight sweep, character and scene original painting slicing and reorganization, and AE lens pushing and pulling through the clouds, and finally the game LOGO is composed of stars.

cards.title: 《星辉之城》魔法师 PV II
cards.prompt: 为《星辉之城》的少年魔法师制作史诗奇幻二次元角色PV：展现云海城市、魔法学院、星轨与巨兽，加入魔法地图遮罩、符文文字运动、星光扫过、角色与场景原画切片重组和AE镜头穿云推拉，最终由星辰组成游戏LOGO。
cards.promptEn: Create an epic fantasy two-dimensional character PV for the young magician of "City of Stars": showing the cloud sea city, magic academy, star trails and giant beasts, adding magic map mask, rune text movement, starlight sweep, character and scene original painting slicing and reorganization, and AE lens pushing and pulling through the clouds, and finally the game LOGO is composed of stars.

cards.title: 紫发枪械少女 PV
cards.prompt: 请锁定参考图中的紫发少女与巨型枪械，制作粉白黑深紫的二次元角色PV：融合巨字排版、2.5D切片、枪械特写与技能爆发，加入动态遮罩、文字穿屏、枪口光影扫过、角色原画切片重组和AE推拉摇移，结尾定格为角色宣传KV。
cards.promptEn: Please focus on the purple-haired girl and the giant gun in the reference picture, and create a two-dimensional character PV of pink, white, black and deep purple: integrating giant typesetting, 2.5D slicing, gun close-ups and skill bursts, adding dynamic masking, text through the screen, muzzle light and shadow sweeping, character original painting slice reorganization and AE push-pull pan, and the ending is fixed as a character promotion KV.

cards.title: 女子青春乐队 PV
cards.prompt: 帮我制作全女性青春乐队题材二次元游戏PV：保持成员、乐器和站位一致，采用蓝白赛璐璐新番风，表现排练、登台、灯光和演奏高潮，加入舞台遮罩、歌词/成员名运动、追光扫过、原画切片重组和AE镜头推拉，最后形成乐队海报。
cards.promptEn: Create a 2D game PV about an all-female youth band: keep the members, instruments and positions consistent, use a new style of blue and white celluloid to show the rehearsal, stage, lighting and performance climax, add stage mask, lyrics/member name movement, follow-up light sweep, original painting slice reorganization and AE lens push-and-pull, and finally form a band poster.

cards.title: 《盲星之魔女》角色 PV
cards.prompt: 为《盲星之魔女》的女主制作二次元角色PV：围绕星光杯、哥特服饰和星图排版展开神秘觉醒，加入星图圆环遮罩、标题字块运动、星辉扫过、角色原画切片重组和AE镜头推拉环绕，结尾让星座线条组成片名并保持稳定定版。
cards.promptEn: Create a 2D character PV for the heroine of "The Witch of the Blind Star": a mysterious awakening around the starlight cup, gothic costumes and star map layout. Add star map ring mask, title block movement, star sweep, character original painting slice reorganization and AE lens push-pull surround. At the end, the constellation lines form the title and remain stable and finalized.

cards.title: 都市异能 JRPG PV
cards.prompt: 帮我制作原创都市异能二次元游戏PV：采用红黑白JRPG、漫画拼贴与叛逆潮流风格，表现角色穿越街区、异能爆发和城市碎片化，加入漫画格遮罩、巨大标题滑入、霓虹光影扫过、原画切片重组和AE推拉冲镜，最终形成强烈角色KV。
cards.promptEn: Create an original urban superpower 2D game PV: using red and black and white JRPG, comic collage and rebellious trend style, showing the character crossing the street, superpower explosion and urban fragmentation, adding comic grid mask, huge title sliding in, neon light and shadow sweeping, original painting slicing and reorganization and AE push-pull camera, finally forming a strong character KV.

cards.title: 白色虚空科幻游戏 PV
cards.prompt: 制作一支15秒原创日系科幻游戏PV：在纯白虚空、黑色未来都市与蓝色星核之间展开文明解析、数据觉醒和机械生命融合；加入机械圆环遮罩揭示、英文字体运动、青绿光影扫过、城市原画切片重组及AE镜头推拉环绕，配合空灵女声与电子摇滚，最终聚合为游戏Logo定版。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second original Japanese science fiction game PV: civilized analysis, data awakening and mechanical life integration between pure white void, black future city and blue star core; adding mechanical ring mask reveal, English font movement, green light and shadow sweep, city original painting slice reorganization and AE lens push-pull surround, combined with ethereal female voice and electronic rock, and finally aggregated into the final version of the game logo.

cards.title: 暗黑宫廷少女 PV
cards.prompt: 请锁定参考图中宫廷少女的五官、服饰与珠宝，制作黑红幽蓝、诡丽低血腥的二次元角色PV：突出宫廷凝视、珠宝微距和暗色舞台，加入幕布遮罩、贵族标题运动、冷暖光影扫过、人物原画切片重组和AE镜头推拉，结尾定格为神秘角色海报。
cards.promptEn: Please refer to the facial features, clothing and jewelry of the palace girl in the picture to create a black, red and blue, eerie and low-blooded two-dimensional character PV: highlight the palace gaze, jewelry macro and dark stage, add curtain mask, aristocratic title movement, cold and warm light and shadow sweeping, original character painting slices and reorganization, and AE lens push-and-pull, and the ending is fixed as a mysterious character poster.

cards.title: 白发金瞳剑士 PV
cards.prompt: 请锁定参考图中的白发金瞳剑士与长刀，制作蓝黑水墨、樱花宣纸与书法卡点风的二次元战斗PV：表现拔刀、踏风、刀光和樱花爆发，加入水墨遮罩、书法大字运动、剑光扫过、战斗原画切片重组和AE推拉跟随，最后形成水墨英雄定版。
cards.promptEn: Please focus on the white-haired, golden-eyed swordsman and long sword in the reference picture, and create a two-dimensional battle PV with blue and black ink, cherry blossom rice paper, and calligraphy stuck in the wind: showing sword drawing, wind walking, sword light, and cherry blossom bursts, adding ink masking, calligraphy movement, sword light sweeping, battle original painting slicing and reorganization, and AE push-pull following, and finally the final version of the ink hero is formed.

cards.title: Y2K 电音角色 PV
cards.prompt: 请继承参考图中的人物形象，制作15秒Japanese Electro Pop Rap二次元角色PV；采用Y2K波普、瑞士网格、未来UI与高密度动态歌词，让人物眼睛、耳机、服装和全身原画随节拍切换，加入几何遮罩、文字拆分重组、霓虹光扫过及AE快速推拉，最终定格为完整角色海报。
cards.promptEn: Please inherit the character image in the reference picture and create a 15-second Japanese Electro Pop Rap two-dimensional character PV; use Y2K pop, Swiss grid, future UI and high-density dynamic lyrics, so that the character's eyes, headphones, clothing and full-body original paintings switch with the beat, add geometric masks, text splitting and reorganization, neon light sweeps and AE fast push and pull, and finally finalize it into a complete character poster.

cards.title: 日系杂志角色 PV
cards.prompt: 请继承参考图中的人物与版式方向，制作约12秒Japanese Editorial二次元角色PV；融合赛璐璐立绘、胶片孔、拍立得、圆角画框、棋盘格与优雅衬线字，以照片翻转遮罩、文字沿框运动、闪光扫过、人物局部切片重组和AE克制推拉形成清新文艺的杂志式定版。
cards.promptEn: Please follow the characters and layout directions in the reference picture and create a Japanese Editorial two-dimensional character PV of about 12 seconds; combine cel drawings, film holes, polaroids, rounded frames, checkerboards and elegant serif text, and use photo flipping masks, text movement along the frame, flash sweeps, partial slicing and reorganization of characters and AE restrained push-pull to form a fresh and artistic magazine-style layout.

cards.title: MIKA KUROSE 偶像 PV I
cards.prompt: 为MIKA KUROSE制作15秒甜酷偶像二次元音乐PV；采用Kawaii J-Pop、少女漫画分格、甜系杂志拼贴与动态歌词，表现眼睛、手势、服装、耳机和舞台动作，加入爱心遮罩、歌词拆字运动、追光扫过、角色原画切片重组及AE推拉，最后定格为偶像宣传海报。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second sweet and cool idol two-dimensional music PV for MIKA KUROSE; use Kawaii J-Pop, girl comic grids, sweet magazine collage and dynamic lyrics to express eyes, gestures, clothing, headphones and stage movements, add love masks, lyrics word splitting movement, chasing light sweep, character original painting slicing and reorganization and AE push and pull, and finally freeze it into an idol promotional poster.

cards.title: MIKA KUROSE 偶像 PV II
cards.prompt: 为MIKA KUROSE制作15秒甜酷偶像二次元音乐PV；采用Kawaii J-Pop、少女漫画分格、甜系杂志拼贴与动态歌词，表现眼睛、手势、服装、耳机和舞台动作，加入爱心遮罩、歌词拆字运动、追光扫过、角色原画切片重组及AE推拉，最后定格为偶像宣传海报。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second sweet and cool idol two-dimensional music PV for MIKA KUROSE; use Kawaii J-Pop, girl comic grids, sweet magazine collage and dynamic lyrics to express eyes, gestures, clothing, headphones and stage movements, add love masks, lyrics word splitting movement, chasing light sweep, character original painting slicing and reorganization and AE push and pull, and finally freeze it into an idol promotional poster.

cards.title: 四人 J-Pop 乐队 PV
cards.prompt: 为四名固定成员制作15秒三渲二J-Pop乐队MV，保持主唱、贝斯手、鼓手、键盘手的外貌、服装、乐器与站位一致；结合舞台演奏、歌词空间排版和成员互动，加入乐器擦镜遮罩、文字运动、舞台追光扫过、人物切片重组及AE推拉环绕，最后形成完整乐队海报。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second three-rendered two-part J-Pop band MV for the four fixed members, keeping the appearance, clothing, instruments, and positions of the lead singer, bassist, drummer, and keyboardist consistent; combined with stage performance, lyrics space layout, and member interaction, adding instrument masking, text movement, stage tracking, character slice reorganization, and AE push-pull surround, and finally formed a complete band poster.

cards.title: 《HEART//LINK》恋爱喜剧 PV
cards.prompt: 为HINA、REI、YORU、MIU四名固定角色制作15秒横版Galgame恋爱喜剧PV；采用赛璐璐立绘、Q版头像、像素UI和日系MG排版，依次完成角色介绍、窗口快切、道具漩涡与Logo收束，加入圆环遮罩、名字拆字运动、星芒扫过、原画切片重组和AE推拉，最终定版“HEART//LINK”。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second horizontal version of the Galgame love comedy PV for the four fixed characters of HINA, REI, YORU, and MIU; using cel vertical painting, Q-version avatars, pixel UI, and Japanese MG typesetting, character introductions, window fast cuts, prop vortexes, and logo wrapping were completed in sequence, and ring masks, name splitting movements, starburst sweeps, original painting slices and reorganization, and AE push-pull were added to finalize the version of "HEART//LINK".

cards.title: 《FACE THE NIGHT》都市对决 PV
cards.prompt: 为我原创的黑短发制服女刀客与宽帽灰发反派制作15秒冷蓝JRPG PV；以脚步、时钟、月相和酒杯推进都市奇幻剧情，加入剪影反相遮罩、极简文字运动、青蓝光扫过、人物与道具原画切片重组及AE推拉，最后由时钟刻度拼成原创游戏标题与“FACE THE NIGHT”。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second cold blue JRPG PV for my original female swordsman with short black hair in uniform and a gray-haired villain with a wide hat; use footsteps, clocks, moon phases and wine glasses to advance the urban fantasy plot, add silhouette inversion masking, minimalist text movement, blue light sweeping, original painting slicing and reorganization of characters and props, and AE push-pull, and finally use clock scales to spell out the original game title and "FACE THE NIGHT".

cards.title: 《BLUE HOUR》JRPG PV
cards.prompt: 请为原创黑发高中生与队友在午夜死亡主题JRPG中制作约20秒冷蓝PV；表现鞋子、剪影、蝴蝶、精神体、列车与月食，使用时钟刻度与扫描线，加入斜切色块遮罩、英文UI文字运动、蓝白反相扫过、人物原画切片重组及AE推拉低机位跟拍，最后由碎裂时钟拼出“BLUE HOUR / FACE THE NIGHT”。
cards.promptEn: Create about 20 seconds of cold blue PV for an original black-haired high school student and his teammates in a midnight death-themed JRPG; show shoes, silhouettes, butterflies, mental bodies, trains and lunar eclipses, use clock scales and scan lines, add oblique color block masks, English UI text movement, blue and white inverse sweeps, original character painting slices and reorganization, and AE push-pull low-camera tracking. Finally, use a broken clock to spell out "BLUE HOUR / FACE THE NIGHT".

cards.title: 向日葵花海少女 PV
cards.prompt: 请生成12秒日系动漫向日葵花海美少女角色PV，全程无参考图原创：蓝天、暖黄花海、奶油白衣深绿裙与向日葵发饰的少女贯穿全片，加入胶片孔遮罩、动态歌词运动、温暖侧逆光扫过、人物与照片原画切片重组及AE克制推拉，最终合成一张完整向日葵海报。
cards.promptEn: Please generate a 12-second PV of the beautiful girl character in the Japanese anime Sunflower Flower Sea. The whole process is original without reference pictures: the blue sky, the warm yellow flower sea, the girl in cream white dress, dark green skirt and sunflower hair accessories are throughout the film. Add film hole mask, dynamic lyrics movement, warm side backlight sweep, character and photo original painting slice reorganization and AE restrained push and pull, and finally synthesize a complete sunflower poster.

cards.title: 《青にほどける》青春动画 PV
cards.prompt: 请为原创双女主朝仓ひより与水瀬しずく制作15秒日系青春动画PV《青にほどける》；以夕阳教室、天台、电车站和海边坡道串联生活片段与日语念白，加入阳光过曝遮罩、日文衬线文字运动、暖光侧逆光扫过、两人原画切片重组及AE慢速推拉，结尾以水彩蓝晕定版片名。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second Japanese youth animation PV "Ao Kokoro" for the original two heroines Asakura Asakura and Mizunase Koko; use sunset classrooms, rooftops, tram stops and seaside ramps to connect life The clips and Japanese narration were added with sunlight overexposure masks, Japanese serif text movements, warm side backlight sweeps, reorganization of the two people's original painting slices and slow AE push-pull, and ended with a watercolor blue halo to finalize the title.

cards.title: 未来都市游戏片头
cards.prompt: 请用MiniMax H3依次生成两个15秒连续片段。制作16:9二次元科幻游戏PV，分析图1-7：图4锁定角色，其余按原提示绑定场景、界面、构图与风格。第一段呈现电梯开启、身份扫描及START交互；第二段呈现天台奔跑、翻越落地和MINIMAX大厦揭示。统一人物、服装、光色、运镜、旁白与音效。
cards.promptEn: Use MiniMax H3 to sequentially generate two continuous 15-second clips for a 16:9 anime-style sci-fi game PV. Analyze Images 1–7: use Image 4 to lock the character’s identity, and bind the remaining images to the environments, UI, composition, and visual style according to the original instructions. In the first clip, show the elevator opening, identity scan, and START interaction. In the second, show the rooftop run, vault and landing, followed by the reveal of the MINIMAX tower. Maintain consistent character identity, clothing, lighting, camera movement, voice-over, and sound throughout.

cards.title: 赛博角色装备界面
cards.prompt: 请用MiniMax H3制作一条15秒、16:9二次元赛博游戏角色PV。以输入图锁定角色身份、脸部、服装与义肢，并提取UI、色彩和画风参考。按原分镜呈现菜单点击、双臂装备重构、配置确认、环境加载及第三人称入城；确保人物、装备、界面文字、动作因果、镜头与声音连续。先确认完整分镜和最终提示词，再整条生成并质检。
cards.promptEn: Use MiniMax H3 to create a 15-second, 16:9 anime-style cyberpunk game character PV. Use the input image to lock the character’s identity, face, outfit, and prosthetic limbs, while extracting references for the UI, color palette, and visual style. Follow the original storyboard to show menu interaction, arm reconfiguration, configuration confirmation, environment loading, and third-person city entry. Maintain continuity across the character, equipment, UI text, actions, camera work, and sound. Confirm the complete storyboard and final prompt before generating and reviewing the full video.

cards.title: 《終末残響》末日拼贴 PV
cards.prompt: 请生成15秒纯二维末日故障拼贴游戏PV，原创少女“凛”穿旧制服、红围巾与磁带播放器穿越废墟；以故障开机、人物定格拼贴、废土开放世界、Collage爆发和最终海报组成结构，加入扫描线遮罩、日文文字运动、荧光青光扫过、角色与废墟原画切片重组及AE横向Tracking推拉，最终定版《終末残響》。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second purely 2D apocalyptic glitch-collage game PV. An original girl, Rin, wearing an old uniform, red scarf, and cassette player crosses ruins. Structure it with glitch boot-up, freeze-frame character collage, wasteland open world, collage burst, and final poster; add scanline masks, Japanese text motion, fluorescent cyan sweeps, sliced recombination of character and ruin artwork, and horizontal AE tracking push/pulls, ending on 《終末残響》.

cards.title: 《AFTER//EDEN》末日游戏 PV
cards.prompt: 请制作《AFTER//EDEN》15秒FUI故障艺术末日游戏PV：以系统启动失败、写实漫画格展开、红色扫描线转真实3A游戏CG、未来城市、城市花海、赛博山林和标题卡收束为主线；加入数据裂缝遮罩、FUI文字运动、红色扫描光扫过、漫画/CG原画切片重组及AE三维图层推拉视差，最终出现“AFTER//EDEN / RECLAIM THE LOST WORLD”。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second FUI glitch-art apocalyptic game PV for AFTER//EDEN. Follow a storyline of failed system boot, realistic comic panels, red scanlines transforming into real AAA game CG, a futuristic city, a city of flowers, cyber forests, and a title-card close. Add data-crack masks, FUI text motion, red scanning-light sweeps, sliced recombination of comic/CG artwork, and 3D AE layer push/pull parallax, ending with “AFTER//EDEN / RECLAIM THE LOST WORLD”.

Following the TVC animation structure of @Video1, the hot and sour elements are changed to sea water, salt crystals and crispy potato chips: the packaging is suspended and rotated, the water and salt vortex shuttles, the potato chips explode, the kaleidoscope converges, and the salt rock hero freezes on the water; no one, no new subtitles, with strong rhythm electronic music and crisp sounds.

cards.title: 官网首屏产品功能演示
cards.prompt: 帮我制作一条 15 秒、16:9 的官网首屏产品功能短片。 风格简洁、科技感、留白充足；不需要人物口播，以界面操作、关键结果和轻量环境音为主。
cards.promptEn: Create a 15-second, 16:9 short product feature video on the first screen of the official website. The style is concise, technological, and has plenty of white space; no characters are required to speak, and it focuses on interface operations, key results, and lightweight ambient sounds.

cards.title: 鞋履品牌落地页
cards.prompt: 用minimax h3生成，15 秒，16:9。一个网站页面，网站页面UI设计，网站动效，视频展示了流畅的网页向下滚动效果。一个极具爆发力与动感的耐克（Nike）官网风格产品落地页 UI/UX 演示视频，核心展示主体是该产品图片1。页面采用粗犷有力、倾斜的超大号无衬线字体进行张扬的排版。背景有极具速度感的动态光影、暗色碳纤维或运动透气网眼纹理在交织变换。视频展示了节奏紧凑、充满力量感的网页向下滚动效果，以及鼠标悬停时强烈的视觉放大与颜色反转等 UI 交互动作。
cards.promptEn: Generated with minimax h3, 15 seconds, 16:9. A website page, website page UI design, website animation, and video showing the smooth scrolling down effect of the web page. A very explosive and dynamic Nike official website style product landing page UI/UX demonstration video, the core display subject is the product picture 1. The page uses bold, powerful, slanted oversized sans serif fonts for bold layout. The background has a sense of speed, dynamic light and shadow, dark carbon fiber or sports breathable mesh textures that are intertwined and transformed. The video shows the fast-paced and powerful scrolling down effect of the web page, as well as UI interactive actions such as strong visual amplification and color inversion when the mouse is hovered.

cards.title: MiniMax H3 霓虹 CG 标题片
cards.prompt: 通过 Minimax H3、15 秒、16:9 生成。严格遵循： 黑色空间中的“MiniMaxH3”超风格化 CG 3D 霓虹灯标题序列。有光泽的液态金属/玻璃字母会爆炸、翻转、变形、故障、破碎，并通过 RGB 分割、像素排序、色差、光线追踪反射和体积霓虹灯重新排列。 未来派街头服饰角色在版式中移动：敲打旋转的数字、冲浪字母流、向镜头扔出一个巨大的“M”、将旋转的数字踢成彩色的粒子爆发。字母与身体碰撞，缠绕在四肢上。 最后 3 秒：所有文本围绕角色旋转，然后折叠成一个干净发光的 3D 标题锁定：“MiniMaxH3”，带有小标语“Beyond the Code”。电影轨道、快速平移、景深、完全 CG 3D，无平面 2D。
cards.promptEn: Generate via Minimax H3, 15s, 16:9. Strictly follow: A hyper-stylized CG 3D neon title sequence for “MiniMaxH3” in a black void. Glossy liquid-metal/glass letters explode, flip, morph, glitch, shatter and rearrange with RGB split, pixel sorting, chromatic aberration, ray-traced reflections and volumetric neon light. A futuristic streetwear character moves through the typography: punching spinning numbers, surfing letter streams, throwing a giant “M” at camera, spin-kicking digits into colorful particle bursts. Letters collide with the body and wrap around limbs. Final 3s: all text orbits the character, then collapses into a clean glowing 3D title lock-up: “MiniMaxH3”, with small tagline “Beyond the Code”. Cinematic orbits, whip-pans, depth of field, fully CG 3D, no flat 2D.

cards.title: 代码与 CRT 蒙太奇
cards.prompt: 用minimax h3生成，15 秒，16:9。必须遵循以下提示词，不允许改动：高感光度动态影像，少量淡化 CRT 显像管图像和C++ 代码元素如虚影般淡淡地浮现上下滚动，按图片1、图片2、图片3、图片4、图片5的顺序流畅衔接转场，全片统一叠加自然浓密的胶片颗粒；增加细微晃动的水平 VHS 扫描线；镜头高速运动时，强化蓝红色彩分离的色差畸变；转场画面随机添加数字画面撕裂、色块失真。
cards.promptEn: Generated with minimax h3, 15 seconds, 16:9. The following prompts must be followed and modifications are not allowed: High-sensitivity dynamic images, a small amount of dilution, CRT picture tube images and C++ code elements appear faintly like ghosts. Scroll up and down, smooth transitions in the order of picture 1, picture 2, picture 3, picture 4, and picture 5. The whole film is uniformly superimposed with natural and dense film grains; increase the level of subtle shaking VHS Scan lines; when the lens moves at high speed, the chromatic aberration distortion of blue and red color separation is strengthened; digital screen tearing and color block distortion are randomly added to transition pictures.

cards.title: 空间音频工具 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，原创空间音频工具ECHO FIELD，保留“SOUND BECOMES SPACE.”。把人声、打击乐、环境声和低频化为可抓取拖拽的节点、球体、织带与波形：移动人声位置、拉宽声场、调节混响、展开时间轨道并重排节奏，最后切换IMMERSIVE并进入声音雕塑。深灰磨砂玻璃与柔和体积光，禁Bento、调音台、霓虹HUD和跳动数字。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, original spatial audio tool ECHO FIELD, retain "SOUND BECOMES SPACE." Turn vocals, percussion, ambient sounds and low frequencies into grabbable and draggable nodes, spheres, ribbons and waveforms: move the vocal position, widen the sound field, adjust the reverb, expand the time track and rearrange the rhythm, and finally switch to IMMERSIVE and enter sound sculpture. Dark gray frosted glass and soft volumetric light ban Bento, mixer, neon HUD and jumping numbers.

cards.title: 艺术馆空间 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，以真实当代艺术馆呈现“REALITY BECOMES A WORKSPACE.”。参观者唤起锚定展品的多层弹窗，展开详情并拆分图片、材质和颜色工具；拖拽色片改变雕塑灯光，播放声音，合并两件作品比较，收藏窗口随身跟随，再把内容传入下一展厅的真实装置。深色半透明空间材质、准确遮挡与景深，仅保留指定英文操作词，禁数字和科幻空舱。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation and present "REALITY BECOMES A WORKSPACE." in a real contemporary art museum. Visitors evoke the multi-layered pop-up window that anchors the exhibit, expand the details and split images, materials and color tools; drag the color chip to change the lighting of the sculpture, play sound, merge two works for comparison, follow the collection window, and then transfer the content to the real installation in the next exhibition hall. Dark translucent space material, accurate occlusion and depth of field, only designated English operation words are retained, and numbers and sci-fi empty cabins are prohibited.

cards.title: 旅行策划应用 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，旅行策划应用VELA，保留“JOURNEYS, COMPOSED.”。以编辑式旅行画布承载地图、路线、照片与文字：探索LISBON，拖拽RIVER WALK更新路线，展开地点详情并收藏，在JOURNEY BOARD重排照片，切换OCEAN、TERRACOTTA、OLIVE主题，最终折叠回VELA。暖石白纸感、低饱和照片和共享转场，禁Bento、仿Apple界面及跳动数字。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, travel planning application VELA, keep "JOURNEYS, COMPOSED." An editable travel canvas carries maps, routes, photos and text: explore LISBON, drag RIVER WALK to update routes, expand location details and collect them, rearrange photos on JOURNEY BOARD, switch OCEAN, TERRACOTTA, OLIVE themes, and finally fold back to VELA. Warm stone white paper feel, desaturated photos and shared transitions, banned Bento, imitation Apple interface and jumping numbers.

cards.title: 便利店空间 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，写实雨夜便利店里，刚下班的年轻人选咖啡与零食、付款并坐到窗边。空间弹窗从雨湿玻璃门展开，锚定咖啡机、货架和柜台；COFFEE卡被拖到咖啡机，BOLD与MILK合并，SNACK加入订单，PAY贴合柜台，READY吸附纸袋并随人物到窗边。冷蓝雨夜与暖琥珀店光、磨砂亚克力和真实遮挡反射，仅保留指定英文，无品牌Logo和数字。
cards.promptEn: Make a UI animation to realistically describe a young man who has just gotten off work in a convenience store on a rainy night, choosing coffee and snacks, paying and sitting by the window. The space pop-up window unfolds from the rain-wet glass door, anchoring the coffee machine, shelves and counters; the COFFEE card is dragged to the coffee machine, BOLD is merged with MILK, SNACK is added to the order, PAY is attached to the counter, READY absorbs the paper bag and follows people to the window. Cold blue rainy night with warm amber store light, frosted acrylic and real occlusion reflection, only the designated English language is retained, without brand logo and numbers.

cards.title: 未来游戏商店 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，第一人称进入原创未来游戏商店。鼠标点击WEAPONS展开3D武器库，悬停查看旋转、属性与稀有度，选中传奇武器后拖拽检查细节，再点击UPGRADE安装模块、点击BUY NOW并显示PURCHASE COMPLETE。采用暗玻璃、霓虹与高级赛博游戏商城质感，交互顺序清晰，保留STORE、LEGENDARY ITEM等指定英文状态。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and enter the original future game store in first person. Click on WEAPONS to expand the 3D weapon library, hover to view the rotation, attributes and rarity, select the legendary weapon and drag it to check the details, then click UPGRADE to install the module, click BUY NOW and display PURCHASE COMPLETE. It adopts dark glass, neon and high-end cyber game mall textures, with clear interaction sequence, and retains designated English status such as STORE and LEGENDARY ITEM.

cards.title: 荒野生存角色创建 UI
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌RUSTLAND荒野生存角色创建。真实3D边境人物与锈黑橙工业打字机界面中，鼠标依次选择风霜女性预设、女性体型、拖动下颌、选择深棕长卷发、穿上重型风衣并确认；每段只做一次明确的hover→click→result，禁连点和自动轮播。突出皮肤、发丝、皮革与布料物理，结尾转为金色夕照角色英雄镜头和RUSTLAND标识。
cards.promptEn: UI animation, brand RUSTLAND wilderness survival character creation. In the interface of a real 3D border character and a rusty black and orange industrial typewriter, the mouse selects the weathered female preset, female body shape, drags the chin, selects long dark brown curly hair, puts on a heavy windbreaker and confirms; only perform a clear hover→click→result for each paragraph, and connection points and automatic carousel are prohibited. The physics of skin, hair, leather and cloth are highlighted, and the ending changes to a golden sunset shot of the character hero and the RUSTLAND logo.

cards.title: 智能家居 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌AURA智能家居，保留“Sleep in Color. Wake in Calm.”。从暖居主页进入Bedroom，操作灯光、空调与窗帘；设备卡拆成悬浮模块再精准归位，随后选择GOOD NIGHT，让灯光、窗帘与夜间环境联动，最终回到AURA品牌。暖奶油、柔琥珀与Hygge圆角微动效，统一半透明圆点触发；禁仿现有智能家居、玻璃堆叠、深色HUD和霓虹。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, brand AURA smart home, retain "Sleep in Color. Wake in Calm." Enter the Bedroom from the Nuanju homepage to operate lights, air conditioners and curtains; disassemble the equipment card into a floating module and return it to its precise position, then select GOOD NIGHT to link the lights, curtains with the nighttime environment, and finally return to the AURA brand. Warm cream, soft amber and hygge rounded corner micro-motion effects, unified translucent dot triggers; it is forbidden to imitate existing smart homes, glass stacks, dark HUDs and neon.

cards.title: 创作编辑套件 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌Lumen创作编辑套件。深炭网格、紫粉青极光与统一玻璃面板中，依次展示Pen工具悬停提示、拖拽卡片双轴智能对齐、多选并Group、时间轴播放/拖动/缩放、饱和度调节与前后对比、Bezier曲线选择Ease In-Out，最后所有面板退场并落版“Lumen / Motion & Design, Reimagined”。动效精确、专业、可触发，避免硬切和杂乱面板。
cards.promptEn: For UI animation, brand Lumen creation and editing suite. In the dark charcoal grid, purple-pink-cyan aurora and unified glass panel, the Pen tool hover prompts, drag and drop card dual-axis smart alignment, multi-select and group, timeline play/drag/zoom, saturation adjustment and before-and-after comparison, Bezier curve selection Ease In-Out, and finally all panels exit and "Lumen / Motion & Design, Reimagined" is dropped. Motion effects are precise, professional, and triggerable to avoid hard cuts and cluttered panels.

cards.title: 视觉识别助手 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌Loupe视觉识别助手，保留“Look closer.”。先扫描龟背竹，弹出识别、养护、相似商品和Ask AI动作，展开养护信息与AI建议；再以共享转场扫描拿铁，弹出Brew origin、Nutrition、Nearby cafes、Ask AI，展开埃塞俄比亚咖啡信息并反馈AI建议，最后落版Loupe。白底薄荷绿与暖橙分区，半透明圆点触发，禁仿现有识别App。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, brand Loupe visual recognition assistant, keep "Look closer." First, scan the Monstera deliciosa, and the identification, conservation, similar products, and Ask AI actions will pop up, and the maintenance information and AI suggestions will be displayed; then scan the latte with a shared transition, and the Brew origin, Nutrition, Nearby cafes, and Ask AI will pop up, and the Ethiopian coffee information will be displayed and AI suggestions will be fed back, and finally Loupe will be launched. The white background is divided into mint green and warm orange, and is triggered by translucent dots. It is forbidden to imitate existing recognition apps.

cards.title: 三维空间笔记 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌Strata三维空间笔记，保留“Think in layers.”。在深蓝灰思维星云中，鼠标以视差悬停Today's Spark并点击进入子节点，翻转Notes查看内容，拖动空白旋转空间，再连接Today's Spark、Project Ideas与Daily Notes，最后节点退场落版Strata。青蓝发光卡片、柔粉关键节点、弧形连线与真实景深，禁平面看板和廉价霓虹。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations, brand Strata three-dimensional space notes, and keep "Think in layers." In the dark blue-gray thinking nebula, hover the mouse over Today's Spark with parallax and click to enter the sub-node, flip Notes to view the content, drag the blank rotation space, and then connect Today's Spark, Project Ideas and Daily Notes, and finally the node exits and is replaced by Strata. Green-blue luminous cards, soft pink key nodes, arc-shaped connections and real depth of field, prohibiting flat signboards and cheap neon.

cards.title: 手工墨镜网站 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌NOIR东京手工墨镜，保留noir.com与“Vision, refined.”。全程模拟真实浏览器：鼠标控制Hero墨镜多层视差旋转，滚动浏览工艺与Collection，悬停并点击The Pilot进入详情，继续旋转产品、切换玳瑁配色并Add to Bag，最后关闭浏览器落版NOIR。炭黑、暖白与克制金色的编辑杂志官网质感，英文清晰稳定，禁仿现有墨镜品牌、霓虹和玻璃堆叠。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, brand NOIR Tokyo handmade sunglasses, retain noir.com and "Vision, refined." The whole process simulates a real browser: the mouse controls the multi-layer parallax rotation of Hero sunglasses, scrolls through the craftsmanship and collection, hovers and clicks on The Pilot to enter the details, continues to rotate the product, switches the tortoise shell color and Add to Bag, and finally closes the browser and logs NOIR. The texture of the editorial magazine official website is carbon black, warm white and restrained gold. The English is clear and stable, and it is forbidden to imitate existing sunglasses brands, neon and glass.

cards.title: 音乐平台网页 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌Aria高端音乐发现平台，保留aria.fm、“Sound, with soul.”。全程真实浏览器框架：鼠标让Late Night Jazz封面产生分层视差，点击播放使封面与控制条按节拍呼吸；滚动浏览音乐内容，进入专辑详情并完成播放列表操作，最后关闭浏览器落版Aria。采用深夜蓝黑、暖白、暖橙和少量柔粉的动态音乐杂志风，交互与音乐反馈同步，禁仿现有音乐平台、霓虹和杂乱界面。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, brand Aria high-end music discovery platform, retain aria.fm, "Sound, with soul." Real browser framework throughout: the mouse creates layered parallax on the Late Night Jazz cover, click play to make the cover and control bars breathe according to the beat; scroll through the music content, enter the album details and complete the playlist operation, and finally close the browser and launch Aria. It adopts the dynamic music magazine style of late night blue and black, warm white, warm orange and a small amount of soft pink. The interaction is synchronized with the music feedback, and it is forbidden to imitate the existing music platform, neon and cluttered interface.

cards.title: AR 眼镜咖啡馆 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，第一人称佩戴AR眼镜进入暖光咖啡馆。凝视扫描咖啡杯，展开Single Origin Ethiopia与Order、Details、Save动作；打开风味详情，同时识别书本、天气和今日特饮，凝视Add to Order后出现购物袋与咖啡全息模型，最后抬眼让界面退场并显示Aria品牌。卡片须锚定现实物体并随视角变化，半透明白配暖橙，禁语音、霓虹和脱离物体的漂浮UI。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation and wear AR glasses to enter the warm light cafe in the first person. Scan the coffee cup with your gaze to launch the Single Origin Ethiopia and Order, Details, and Save actions; open the flavor details and identify the book, weather, and today's special drink at the same time; gaze at Add to Order and a shopping bag and coffee holographic model will appear, and finally raise your eyes to exit the interface and display the Aria brand. Cards must be anchored to real objects and change with the viewing angle. They must be translucent white with warm orange. Voice, neon, and floating UI separated from objects are prohibited.

cards.title: 治愈收集游戏 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌Bloom治愈收集游戏，保留“Tap to bloom.”。在暖米白绘本界面中，鼠标短按把圆形、水滴与心形粒子聚合成萤火虫，长按将其分散；随后聚合小鱼、种子、贝壳和羽毛，让多个生物共同轻柔漂浮，最终退场落版Bloom。使用低饱和莫兰迪色、手写标题、圆润2D有机粒子与钢琴木琴音效，所有运动由鼠标触发，禁3D、深色、霓虹和静态展示。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, brand Bloom healing collection game, keep "Tap to bloom." In the warm beige picture book interface, short-press the mouse to aggregate circles, water droplets, and heart-shaped particles into fireflies, and long-press to disperse them; then aggregate small fish, seeds, shells, and feathers to make multiple creatures float gently together, and finally exit and release Bloom. Use low-saturated Morandi colors, handwritten titles, rounded 2D organic particles and piano xylophone sound effects. All movements are triggered by the mouse. 3D, dark, neon and static displays are prohibited.

cards.title: 音乐驱动动态视觉
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，创作音乐驱动的实验性数字视觉：在极简图形空间中，让界面、形状和线条按节拍运动；动感字体随音乐扩张、拆分、旋转和变形，图标、符号与多层组件同步组合，最终形成未来感动态海报。融合时尚科技、kinetic typography与专业AE动态图形，节拍明确、转场流畅，禁止静态UI陈列。
cards.promptEn: Do UI animation and create experimental digital vision driven by music: in a minimalist graphic space, let the interface, shapes and lines move according to the beat; dynamic fonts expand, split, rotate and deform with the music, icons, symbols and multi-layer components are combined simultaneously to ultimately form a futuristic dynamic poster. Integrating fashion technology, kinetic typography and professional AE dynamic graphics, the rhythm is clear, the transition is smooth, and static UI display is prohibited.

cards.title: 赛博游戏系统界面
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，打造原创AAA赛博游戏系统界面。扫描光束在暗色空间启动多层战术HUD，展开状态面板、地图、圆形雷达、角色信息与能量模块；镜头深入后由玩家操作面板、图标、技术图与系统模块，窗口高速滑动合并，3D模型旋转、数据流连接，最终组装成完整游戏菜单。采用机械动画、克制故障、粒子与电影级镜头，保留原创占位技术文字，禁真实游戏Logo。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and create original AAA cyber game system interface. The scanning beam activates the multi-layered tactical HUD in the dark space, unfolding the status panel, map, circular radar, character information and energy modules; after the camera goes deep, the player operates the panel, icons, technical diagrams and system modules, the windows slide and merge at high speed, the 3D model is rotated, the data stream is connected, and finally assembled into a complete game menu. It uses mechanical animation, controlled glitches, particles, and cinematic lenses, retains original placeholder technical text, and prohibits real game logos.

cards.title: 军事角色档案式 PV
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，制作未来军事角色档案式游戏PV，不做科技HUD或软件界面。深灰纸张、磨砂玻璃、米白排版与暗红引导线组成一本被拆入三维空间的高级机密杂志：先出现巨大编号“08”与OPERATOR RECORD，再沿红线展开人物身份、组织状态和抽象能力关系模块，随后纸张与玻璃层重组为立体角色档案海报。强调编辑排版、留白、纸张颗粒和视差穿梭，禁普通属性栏与复杂背景。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and create future military character archive-style game PVs, not technology HUD or software interfaces. Dark gray paper, frosted glass, off-white typesetting and dark red guide lines form a high-level secret magazine that is dismantled into a three-dimensional space: first the huge number "08" and OPERATOR RECORD appear, and then the relationship modules of character identity, organizational status and abstract abilities are unfolded along the red line, and then the paper and glass layers are reorganized into a three-dimensional character archive poster. Emphasize editing layout, white space, paper grain and parallax shuttle, and prohibit ordinary attribute bars and complex backgrounds.

cards.title: 桌面音乐软件 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，创作高端桌面音乐软件。炭黑、奶油、银色、深红与金色的编辑式界面中，鼠标悬停音乐库和专辑卡，选中专辑后封面扩展并露出缓慢旋转的黑胶；继续选择歌单、拖动时间轴、切歌与调节声音，让波形、歌词和音乐信息自然响应，再穿行收藏、艺人、歌单创建和音频设置，最终组合为完整音乐体验。玻璃面板与黑胶只作精致材质元素，禁喧宾夺主和廉价动效。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and create high-end desktop music software. In the editing interface of carbon black, cream, silver, crimson and gold, hover the mouse over the music library and album card, select the album and the cover expands to reveal the slowly rotating vinyl; continue to select the playlist, drag the timeline, cut songs and adjust the sound, so that the waveform, lyrics and music information respond naturally, and then go through the collection, artist, playlist creation and audio settings, and finally combine it into a complete music experience. Glass panels and vinyl are used only as exquisite material elements, and no overpowering or cheap animation effects are allowed.

cards.title: 工业设计档案分析
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，以未来工业设计档案分析一个神秘3D物体。黑白灰界面配细蓝图线与少量红色，先扫描识别实物并出现坐标与工程标记，再把表面转成线框、CAD图和技术草图；组件进入三维爆炸视图，镜头穿过结构与连线，随后蓝图和真实材质重新融合，最终形成带编辑字体的高级标题画面。保持理性、精密、艺术化的研究文档质感，禁传统全息HUD、廉价赛博与杂乱数据。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and analyze a mysterious 3D object with future industrial design files. The black-and-white and gray interface is paired with thin blueprint lines and a small amount of red. The physical object is first scanned and identified, and coordinates and engineering marks appear. Then the surface is converted into wireframes, CAD drawings and technical sketches. The components enter a three-dimensional exploded view, and the camera passes through the structure and connections. Then the blueprint and real materials are re-integrated, finally forming an advanced title screen with edited fonts. Maintain the rational, precise, and artistic quality of research documents, and prohibit traditional holographic HUDs, cheap cyberspace, and messy data.

cards.title: SaaS 产品使用路径动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，创作现代SaaS产品广告，重点表现一次完整使用路径而非功能清单。镜头跟随卡片拖拽进入工作区，引发相关面板移动、连接生成和信息连锁重排；继续深入按钮状态切换、组件替换、图表响应与图层组合，最后拉远展示所有数字工作空间流动为统一生态。采用Linear式极简、Figma产品演示感、智能微交互和流体转场，禁静态截图、PPT切页与功能罗列。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and create modern SaaS product ads, focusing on showing a complete usage path rather than a list of functions. The camera follows the card and drags it into the workspace, triggering the movement of relevant panels, the generation of connections, and the rearrangement of information chains; it continues to delve into button state switching, component replacement, chart response, and layer combination, and finally zooms out to show that all digital workspaces flow into a unified ecosystem. It adopts Linear minimalism, Figma product demonstration feel, intelligent micro-interaction and fluid transition, and prohibits static screenshots, PPT page cuts and function lists.

cards.title: 魔法使魔 App UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，魔法学院使魔App中固定淡紫毛、金眼、额头月牙、云尾与透明翼鳍的3D小狐。触摸让它探出卡片并回应，拖拽旋转观察；打开BOND/GROWTH路径完成成长并选择徽章；进入AURA、MARK、CHARM、FORM编辑器切换光环、饰物和形态，展示觉醒预览，最终落版FORM YOUR BOND。月光蓝紫、暖象牙、柔金、玻璃与羊皮纸质感，禁战斗、武器、仿宝可梦或霍格沃茨。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation and fix the 3D fox with lavender fur, golden eyes, crescent moon on the forehead, cloud tail and transparent wing fins in the Magic Academy Magic App. Touch it to reveal the card and respond, drag and rotate to observe; open the BOND/GROWTH path to complete growth and select the badge; enter the AURA, MARK, CHARM, and FORM editors to switch halos, ornaments, and forms, display the awakening preview, and finally release FORM YOUR BOND. Moonlight blue and purple, warm ivory, soft gold, glass and parchment textures, no combat, weapons, imitation Pokémon or Hogwarts.

cards.title: 植物标本生长系统 UI
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，创作完全无文字的高端植物标本与生长桌面系统。以森林绿、羊皮纸、黄铜和博物馆自然科学质感，鼠标选择压叶标本，用放大镜检查叶脉，再以图标切换结构、色板与根系；拖动生长环让种子、幼苗到成株自然变化，操作气候圆盘改变光照与湿度，并用分割线比较干燥和水润状态，最后以叶片、年轮和标本针组成抽象徽记。禁止任何字母、数字、伪文字、霓虹和被动纪录片镜头。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and create a high-end plant specimen and growth desktop system with no text. Using forest green, parchment, brass and museum natural science textures, select the pressed leaf specimen with the mouse, check the leaf veins with a magnifying glass, and then switch the structure, color palette and root system with icons; drag the growth ring to allow natural changes from seeds, seedlings to adult plants, operate the climate disk to change the light and humidity, and use dividing lines to compare dry and moist conditions. Finally, the leaves, growth rings and specimen needles are used to form an abstract emblem. No letters, numbers, fake text, neon, and passive documentary footage are allowed.

cards.title: 室内设计平台 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，原创高端室内设计平台ATELIER，除最终品牌名外全片无文字。暖象牙、石灰岩灰、深橄榄、胡桃木与黄铜界面中，鼠标选择室内项目，切换胡桃木、洞石等真实材质；拖入休闲椅和落地灯，用磁性对齐与有效/无效反馈完成摆放，再操作无字照明圆盘改变晨光到暖夕阳，并拖动分割线对比效果。最终控件退场，只保留完成空间与静止ATELIER。禁浏览器栏、伪文字、SaaS看板和被动建筑漫游。
cards.promptEn: UI animation, original high-end interior design platform ATELIER, no text in the entire film except the final brand name. In the interface of warm ivory, limestone grey, dark olive, walnut and brass, select indoor items with the mouse and switch to real materials such as walnut and travertine; drag in leisure chairs and floor lamps, use magnetic alignment and effective/invalid feedback to complete the placement, then operate the wordless lighting disc to change morning light to warm sunset, and drag the dividing line to contrast the effect. Finally, the control exits, leaving only the completion space and the static ATELIER. Browser bars, fake text, SaaS billboards, and passive building roaming are prohibited.

cards.title: 汽车空间系统 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，汽车空间系统AURORA DRIVE OS，保留“DRIVE BEYOND THE ROAD.”。从工程蓝图生成车身与座舱，激活NAVIGATION路线、AUTONOMOUS环境扫描、ENERGY动力网络、CABIN控制和DRIVE MODE协同，再穿出驾驶舱展示高速Hero Shot。黑银冰蓝配能源绿与暖橙，UI须有真实厚度并融入汽车空间，禁仿现有车机、二维屏幕、廉价霓虹和动态打字。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, car space system AURORA DRIVE OS, retain "DRIVE BEYOND THE ROAD." Generate the body and cockpit from the engineering blueprint, activate the NAVIGATION route, AUTONOMOUS environmental scanning, ENERGY power network, CABIN control and DRIVE MODE collaboration, and then go out of the cockpit to show the high-speed Hero Shot. Black, silver, ice blue with energy green and warm orange. The UI must have real thickness and integrate into the car space. It is forbidden to imitate existing car machines, two-dimensional screens, cheap neon and dynamic typing.

cards.title: 深海生存游戏 UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，原创深海生存战术游戏ABYSS//ECHO，最终落版前完全无文字。固定黑色深海外骨骼士兵，在水下部署舱用物理图标完成装备预览、错误槽位拒绝、正确拖拽安装与取消；切换护盾、推进和平衡装甲模式，以声呐发现结构；拖动海底路线避开危险并锁定遗迹入口，最后通过松手失败与长按成功展示部署确认，开启舱门出发。钛黑、冰青、象牙白与克制琥珀，硬表面机械UI，禁文字数字、平面卡片、廉价全息和被动预告片。
cards.promptEn: UI animation for the original deep-sea survival tactics game ABYSS//ECHO, which had no text at all before final release. Fixed the black deep sea skeletal soldier, using the physical icon in the underwater deployment cabin to complete the equipment preview, wrong slot rejection, correct drag installation and cancellation; switch the shield, propulsion and balanced armor modes, use sonar to discover the structure; drag the submarine route to avoid danger and lock the entrance to the ruins, and finally display the deployment confirmation through the failure of letting go and the successful long press, open the hatch and set off. Titanium black, ice blue, ivory white and restrained amber, hard surface mechanical UI, banned text and numbers, flat cards, cheap holograms and passive trailers.

cards.title: 赛博神经系统启动片
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，打造赛博神经系统启动片。黑金属、热粉紫霓虹、网点、扫描线与克制故障中，紫光唤醒赛博头盔及SYSTEM ONLINE、DATA CONNECTED、NEURAL SCAN；多层HUD展开，光标选中模块后引发扫描环、数据流、警报、几何变形与组件重组，镜头穿越界面，最终形成“NEON SYSTEM / FUTURE RIOT”。保持2D图形与3D纵深、快速但精确，禁随机漂窗和廉价故障。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and create a cyber nervous system startup film. Among the black metal, hot pink purple neon, dots, scan lines and restraint glitches, the purple light awakens the cyber helmet and SYSTEM ONLINE, DATA CONNECTED, NEURAL SCAN; the multi-layer HUD unfolds, and the cursor selects the module to trigger the scanning ring, data flow, alarm, geometric deformation and component reorganization, and the lens passes through the interface, ultimately forming "NEON SYSTEM / FUTURE RIOT". Keep 2D graphics with 3D depth, be fast but precise, and ban random drifting windows and cheap glitches.

cards.title: 未来机器人发布片
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，品牌NEURAL SYSTEM未来机器人发布片。黑色界面、白色工程线与紫色扫描光中，机器人由线框初始化，技术面板连接机械结构、能源核心与硬件模块；光标选择头部进入爆炸视图，展示内部机械、线路、能源和传感器，数据沿连线流动，最后组件归位并落版“NEURAL SYSTEM / NEXT GENERATION”。融合工业蓝图、瑞士排版与高级产品可视化，禁游戏HUD、幻想、卡通和杂乱全息。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation, brand NEURAL SYSTEM future robot launch film. In the black interface, white engineering lines and purple scanning light, the robot is initialized by the wireframe, and the technical panel connects the mechanical structure, energy core and hardware modules; the cursor selects the head to enter the exploded view, showing the internal machinery, circuits, energy sources and sensors. The data flows along the connection lines. Finally, the components are returned and the "NEURAL SYSTEM / NEXT GENERATION" is printed. Blending industrial blueprints, Swiss typography and advanced product visualization, it bans game HUDs, fantasy, cartoons and cluttered holograms.

cards.title: 宠物护理 App UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，创作明快的宠物护理App。奶油米、青绿、柔橙、珊瑚粉与薰衣草色贴纸界面中，金毛犬从宠物卡探出并摇尾、歪头回应触摸；上滑展开SPA、GROOMING、HEALTH、CARE服务，点击后出现泡泡、水滴、毛巾、梳子与清洁反馈，再转为服务目录，最终落版“LOVE YOUR BEST FRIEND / CARE EVERY DAY”。元素由交互触发，禁静态海报、复杂看板、医疗感、暗黑和赛博风。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animation and create a bright pet care app. In the creamy rice, turquoise, soft orange, coral pink and lavender color sticker interface, the golden retriever pokes out from the pet card and wag its tail and tilt its head in response to the touch; swipe up to expand SPA, GROOMING, HEALTH, and CARE services. After clicking, bubbles, water droplets, towels, combs, and cleaning feedback appear, and then it switches to the service catalog, and finally "LOVE YOUR BEST FRIEND / CARE EVERY DAY" is published. Elements are triggered by interaction, and static posters, complex signboards, medical sense, darkness and cyber style are prohibited.

cards.title: 社交头像 App UI 动效
cards.prompt: 做UI动画，创作社交头像App。柔蓝薰衣草渐变与玻璃面板中，可爱3D头像从PROFILE卡探出并微笑、挥手、眨眼；拖拽旋转查看造型，点击统计展开关注、粉丝、经验与徽章，再进入OUTFIT、COLOR、ACCESSORIES、STYLE编辑器切换服装、配饰和颜色，最后将头像、卡片与按钮拆成可触控旋转的三维层并落版“CREATE YOUR AVATAR”。禁平面角色、战斗、武器、随机漂窗和被动展示。
cards.promptEn: Make UI animations and create social avatar apps. In the soft blue lavender gradient and glass panel, the cute 3D avatar pokes out from the PROFILE card and smiles, waves, and winks; drag and rotate to view the shape, click on statistics to expand attention, fans, experience, and badges, and then enter the OUTFIT, COLOR, ACCESSORIES, and STYLE editors to switch clothing, accessories, and colors. Finally, the avatar, cards, and buttons are separated into three-dimensional layers that can be touched and rotated, and "CREATE YOUR AVATAR" is launched. Flat characters, combat, weapons, random floating windows and passive display are prohibited.

cards.title: MiniMax H3 品牌网络动效
cards.prompt: AI品牌UI动效、MiniMax H3品牌片：以“One becomes everyone”为核心，让二维圆点演化为开放网络、H桥梁、三层轨道和品牌字标，画面动态丰富。仅显示“MiniMax H3”“Intelligence With Everyone”；采用暖白、墨黑、信号蓝的平面矢量与瑞士网格风格，禁止3D、渐变和随机粒子。
cards.promptEn: AI brand UI animation, MiniMax H3 brand film: With "One becomes everyone" as the core, the two-dimensional dots evolve into an open network, H bridge, three-layer track and brand logo, and the picture is rich in dynamics. Only "MiniMax H3" and "Intelligence With Everyone" are displayed; flat vector and Swiss grid styles are used in warm white, jet black, and signal blue, and 3D, gradients, and random particles are prohibited.

cards.title: MiniMax H3 多模态网络动效
cards.prompt: MiniMax H3多模态UI动效：以结合两张logo图锁定MiniMax、章鱼Logo和H3波形Logo。发光节点牵引浅蓝连续线，连接TEXT、IMAGE、VIDEO、AUDIO，动态丰富，最终汇聚成H3标志。采用电光蓝、黑蓝、浅青和少量紫的极简MG风格。
cards.promptEn: MiniMax H3 multi-modal UI animation: lock the MiniMax, octopus logo and H3 waveform logo by combining two logo images. The light-emitting nodes pull the light blue continuous line, connecting TEXT, IMAGE, VIDEO, and AUDIO, with rich dynamics, and finally converge into the H3 logo. It adopts the minimalist MG style of electric blue, black blue, light cyan and a small amount of purple.

cards.title: 工业空间舞者追踪动效
cards.prompt: 舞者TD动态追踪。极简工业大空间：水泥灰地面、纯白墙面、顶部天窗。一名短发女性身着黑色紧身连体衣，独自在画面中央跳实验性现代舞。动作大幅度快速方向切换为特征，130 BPM，硬 kick 鼓底，失真合成器贝斯，偶有 crash 镲片，机械感强、和画面里舞蹈的张力同步。红/青色线框，横屏16:9，15秒
cards.promptEn: Dancer TD dynamic tracking. Minimalist industrial large space: cement gray floor, pure white walls, top skylight. A woman with short hair wears a black bodysuit and performs an experimental modern dance alone in the center of the frame. The movements are characterized by large lateral extension of the arms, raising upwards and overhead, squatting with a low center of gravity, sliding sideways on one leg, raising the head and arms, probing and twisting the trunk, and rapid direction switching. The limbs have sharp lines and a strong sense of geometry. They frequently switch between standing, squatting, lunging, and side extension, and the rhythm is relaxed. 130 BPM, hard kick drum base, distorted synthesizer bass, and occasional crash cymbals. It has a strong mechanical feel and is synchronized with the tension of the dance in the picture. Red/cyan wireframe, horizontal screen 16:9, 15 seconds

cards.title: 地下空间舞者追踪动效
cards.prompt:
舞者 TD 动态追踪。场景位于一处混凝土地下空间，一名黑衣短发男子在中央独舞，四肢线条修长。加入红色与青色线框风格的 TD 动态追踪视觉效果。
背景音乐采用实验电子、IDM 与工业氛围风格。
横屏 16:9，时长 15 秒。
cards.promptEn:
Dancer TD dynamic tracking. Set in a concrete underground space, a short-haired man dressed in black performs a solo dance at the center, with long, slender limbs. Add red and cyan wireframe-style TD dynamic tracking effects.
The background music features experimental electronic, IDM, and industrial ambient styles.
Horizontal 16:9, 15 seconds.

cards.title: MiniMax H3 线条雕塑动效
cards.prompt: MiniMax H3黑白实验UI动效：以参考图锁定MiniMax线性Logo与H3字标。使用纯黑白圆角线条连续分叉、缠绕、反相和形变，丰富动态效果，让模态缩写化为图形并融合，最终汇聚成H3与MiniMax Logo。保持先锋、极简、高级科技感，禁止粒子、彩色、普通UI和错误品牌文字。
cards.promptEn: MiniMax H3 black and white experimental UI animation: use the reference image to lock the MiniMax linear logo and H3 wordmark. Pure black and white rounded lines are used to continuously bifurcate, wrap, invert and deform to enrich the dynamic effect, allowing the modal abbreviation to be transformed into graphics and merged, and finally converge into the H3 and MiniMax logos. Maintain a pioneering, minimalist, and advanced sense of technology, and prohibit particles, colors, ordinary UI, and incorrect brand text.

cards.title: 汉堡店 TD 飞散追踪
cards.prompt: 在美式汉堡店，一个男人起身撞到了一个服务员，服务员手里端的餐盘里的好多个汉堡、汉堡的内部的面包配肉饼，生菜等等，还有薯条、可乐的液体飞到空中用TD风格追踪飞起来的这些元素
cards.promptEn: In an American burger restaurant, a man got up and bumped into a waiter. The waiter was holding multiple burgers on the plate, the buns inside the burgers with patties, lettuce, etc., as well as French fries and Coke liquid flying into the air. Use TD style to track these flying elements.

cards.title: 电子乐队 TD 动态追踪
cards.prompt: 电子乐队演出，肢体扭曲夸张，拍摄机位丰富 TD风格 td tracker skill 动态追踪: · 15s 3个男人 造型各异 只穿短裤 赤膊。视频画面黑白，框线使用RGB蓝
cards.promptEn: Electronic band performance, body twists and exaggerations, various shooting camera positions, TD style td tracker skill dynamic tracking: · 15s 3 men with different styles, only wearing shorts and shirtless. The video screen is black and white, and the frame lines use RGB blue.

cards.title: 海中火焰 TD 动态追踪
cards.prompt: 火焰在海里燃烧，框跟随火焰、火苗。td风格
cards.promptEn: The flames burn in the sea, and the frame follows the flames, the flames. td style

cards.title: 双犬负片 TD 动态追踪
cards.prompt: td风格：夜间监控机闪光抓拍场景：黑暗的草地上，两只狗被安保摄像头逮到正在狂吠的瞬间。左边白狗（哈士奇/牧羊混血）嘴大张龇牙狂吠，牙齿舌头全露出。右边巧克力色拉布拉多戴着胸背带和蓝色狗牌，眼睛瞪大、黄绿色虹膜直瞪镜头。机顶闪光灯直打，高光过曝，背景几乎全黑。狂野、失控、被镜头逮个正着的能量。【BGM】激进工业 techno，130 BPM，硬底鼓，失真合成器低音，偶发金属撞击，低频轰鸣像狗的低吼。狂野、失控、后人类质感。格式：16:9 15秒
cards.promptEn: td style: night surveillance camera flash capture scene: on the dark grass, the moment two dogs were caught barking by the security camera.
